# User Preferences

Save the current user's UI preferences.

1 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

<a id="op-preferences-changelanguage"></a>
### POST `/api/Preferences/changeLanguage`

operationId `Preferences_ChangeLanguage` · Changes the user's language preference for the application interface

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `languageCode` | query | string |  | ISO language code (e.g., "en-US", "es-ES", "fr-FR") for the preferred language |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Result](#schema-result) | Language preference updated successfully |
| `400` | [Result](#schema-result) | Invalid language code or language not supported |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have Preferences.ChangeLanguage permission |
| `500` | [Result](#schema-result) | Internal server error while updating preferences |
